verdict.rationale: Docs indicate that Factory sessions can be steered mid-flight — the API lets you 'manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages' for an active Droid session (factory-docs-13), and the Factory App's inline review flow shows Droid 'acting on the feedback in place' during a session (factory-docs-31), implying follow-up steering without restart. However, there's no explicit CLI/UX walkthrough describing how a developer types a follow-up instruction to an in-progress interactive session, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this behavior. Missing for 10: explicit CLI documentation of mid-session follow-up prompting, and independent verification that steering works without restarting the session.
